text:
maria: quick sweep before we call the catalog launch ready for EbbFlow-3B. need confirmations on: licensing status, final perf profile (latency/qps), staging canary schedule, and who will own post-launch monitoring.

raj: owners are me (catalog), @maria (ml), and @jordan (infra). PRs: #4123 (ingest metadata), #4127 (perf profile). both awaiting final review. perf numbers attached below.

maria: thanks — can you paste the perf summary inline? small teams want to know expected p95 for 512 tokens.

raj: short summary: p95(512) = 140ms on g4dn; cpu fallback p95 ~ 1.2s. qps sustained ~ 120 with batch=8. ran with kv-cache enabled. command: `./bench --model ebbflow-3b --seq 512 --batch 8 --kv-cache`

jordan: infra note: staging pool has capacity for a 24h canary (2x g4dn nodes). autoscaler policy will kick in above 80% but we shouldn't hit it with canary traffic. I'll own the rollout window and fallback hooks.

olivia: licensing check: model repo has Apache-2.0 parent, but one dependency (tokenizer-utils) has a non-commercial clause in its CLA. need the source owner to confirm relicensing OR we publish a compatibility note and flag as "restricted" in catalog. not blocking launch, but legal flag required.

sam: product ask: if license requires restricted flag, will that prevent hosted API customers from using it? need an answer before Tue launch decision.

olivia: restricted = can still be listed but UI shows "restricted usage" and sales will escalate for enterprise requests. hosted API can still expose it but we have to add a marketing/legal disclaimer.

raj: action: I'll re-open #4123 to add license metadata + catalog flag. can do in next 2 hours.

maria: perf tweak check — raj, can you try quantized profile Q4 (int8) and post the new p95? if we hit < 110ms we can use it as default for hosted.

raj: will run Q4 now. timeline ~45m. leaving a note for reviewers: please prioritize #4127 (perf) and #4123 (metadata).

deploy-bot: CI started for PR #4127 — 6 checks queued.

jordan: small infra ask: if we use int8, memory drops ~40% so staging canary should run with 4x instances for better tail estimates. I'll update the canary config.

maria: ownership: raj -> catalog + perf, jordan -> canary + infra, olivia -> legal flag + description, sam -> product go/no-go. I'll own followups and launch cron.

raj: Q4 perf results: p95(512,int8) = 105ms on g4dn, qps sustained ~140. pushing perf PR with results now: https://git.company/r/4127

olivia: quick ask for raj: include the tokenizer-utils license URL in the metadata field and tag the model with `license:restricted/tokenizer-utils-nc` so we can track.

raj: done — updated #4123 with license URL and tag. reviewers: @maria @olivia please ack so I can merge.

maria: acked. olivia?

olivia: acked, added legal note to release doc.

deploy-bot: canary job for ebbflow-3b started at 2187654350. 10% traffic ramp scheduled over 2h.

sam: thanks everyone. if canary looks good we aim for Tuesday 09:00 PT public listing. please add any post-launch dashboard alerts you want monitored.

maria: closing loop: i will post a short launch playbook in #product later today with rollback steps. tagging owners again: raj/jordan/olivia/sam. will reconvene if canary shows regressions. :thumbsup:

raj: merging #4123 and #4127 after CI green. will ping when merged.

maria: perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround.
